reference.description: re-computes the Hilbert-band PLV with an independent scipy pipeline (butter+filtfilt+hilbert), verifies ground-truth recovery (phase-locked ~1, independent ~0), and checks the PLV summation formula; reports the op PLV, the scipy PLV + agreement (~8e-5, phase-robust), the exact formula residual, and the locked/unlocked recovery
